name: 50616 · Charles City, IA
findings: ZIP 50616 (Charles City) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50616 (Charles City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50616 (Charles City) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
